library.pt_040:r_0559e33d1b4c397c.text:
A $$ＰＳ$$ of the Balarant army.
He bears the scars of being left near death by the $$レッドショルダー$$, and burns with an abnormal thirst for revenge against $$キリコ$$.
Violent and cruel by nature, he does not choose his methods to win. When $$ロッチナ$$'s information gave him the chance to become Balarant's first $$ＰＳ$$, he did not hesitate to undergo human modification himself.
He later took $$フィアナ$$ hostage and killed $$ボーソン$$, who had been overseeing his own adjustment, to seize command of the land battleship, using every means at his disposal to see $$キリコ$$ dead by his own hand.

library.pt_040:r_99c367dc700ccc9b.text:
A $$ＰＳ$$ of the Balarant army.
He bears the scars of being left near death by the $$レッドショルダー$$, and burns with an abnormal thirst for revenge against $$キリコ$$.
Violent and cruel by nature, he does not choose his methods to win. When $$ロッチナ$$'s information gave him the chance to become Balarant's first $$ＰＳ$$, he did not hesitate to undergo human modification himself.
He later took $$フィアナ$$ hostage and killed $$ボーソン$$, who had been overseeing his own adjustment, to seize command of the land battleship, using every means at his disposal to see $$キリコ$$ dead by his own hand.
He fused with the land battleship to fight $$キリコ$$, who boarded it in an AT, but the ship was infiltrated and he lost $$フィアナ$$ to a rescue. After the land battleship ground to a halt, he sortied in his personal AT, the Eculvis, but $$キリコ$$ and $$シャッコ$$'s teamwork pinned him to the ship's deck; he went berserk, drove the ship into the city of Ah Koba, and vanished in its explosion.

library.pt_040:r_239db62b618f8601.text:
A matchmaker for the Battling circuit in the city of Ah Koba.
An old acquaintance of $$ゴウト$$'s, he shares his shrewd, cunning personality.

library.pt_040:r_948379a600a287d2.text:
A matchmaker for the Battling circuit in the city of Ah Koba.
An old acquaintance of $$ゴウト$$'s, he shares his shrewd, cunning personality.
He pitched $$ゴウト$$ on a $$リアルバトル$$ between $$キリコ$$ and $$ニーバ$$ as a money-making scheme, but when he learned $$キリコ$$ was not interested, he colluded with Balarant instead. As a result, $$フィアナ$$ was kidnapped, and $$キリコ$$ was forced into entering the Battling circuit.

library.pt_040:r_c5a02ba6dd54bdec.text:
A technical officer of the Melkia army.
He was engaged in $$ＰＳ$$ research, and visited the city of Ah Koba in search of $$フィアナ$$.

library.pt_040:r_a94560bed2f7fe7f.text:
A technical officer of the Melkia army.
He was engaged in $$ＰＳ$$ research, and visited the city of Ah Koba in search of $$フィアナ$$.
When $$キリコ$$ asked him whether a $$ＰＳ$$ could be restored to an ordinary human, he answered that it was possible, but was abducted by $$ニーバ$$ immediately afterward. There he was reunited with $$フィアナ$$, who had likewise been taken, but was killed by $$ニーバ$$ when he went berserk.

library.pt_040:r_40d1d5e630e752cb.text:
A Balarant soldier.
On $$ロッチナ$$'s orders, he oversaw the adjustment of $$ニーバ$$, a $$ＰＳ$$.

library.pt_040:r_14eb7db1d868f288.text:
A Balarant soldier.
On $$ロッチナ$$'s orders, he oversaw the adjustment of $$ニーバ$$, a $$ＰＳ$$.
Unable to control the insubordinate $$ニーバ$$, he had him restrained and tried to force him to swear obedience, but $$ニーバ$$ broke free by force and killed him by snapping his neck.

library.pt_040:r_8a6ce680c9d25f5f.text:
The 13th rank of the pan-galactic society $$マーティアル$$, known as the 'Shield of Order.'
She pilots the $$オーデルバックラー$$, the AT issued to the Shield of Order.
She was once in a traffic accident and suffered near-fatal injuries, but survived after her father, Lord $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$, had her modified into a $$ネクスタント$$.
The $$ネクスタント$$ is a bio-weapon born from the failure of the $$ＰＳ$$ project, its body made up mostly of machinery. In addition to superhuman physical ability and reflexes, the function of its 'auxiliary brain,' an artificial brain built for combat, lets it fight as an emotionless weapon, giving it combat strength that surpasses the mentally unstable $$ＰＳ$$.

library.pt_040:r_1613bacfb0423b84.text:
The 13th rank of the pan-galactic society $$マーティアル$$, known as the 'Shield of Order.'
She pilots the $$オーデルバックラー$$, the AT issued to the Shield of Order.
She was once in a traffic accident and suffered near-fatal injuries, but survived after her father, Lord $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$, had her modified into a $$ネクスタント$$.
The $$ネクスタント$$ is a bio-weapon born from the failure of the $$ＰＳ$$ project, its body made up mostly of machinery. In addition to superhuman physical ability and reflexes, the function of its 'auxiliary brain,' an artificial brain built for combat, lets it fight as an emotionless weapon, giving it combat strength that surpasses the mentally unstable $$ＰＳ$$.
In her final battle with $$キリコ$$, she overwhelmed him with the power of her auxiliary brain, but it was shot out by chance, and she lost her combat ability.
At the same time, she learned that the accident that had befallen her and her transformation into a $$ネクスタント$$ had all been her father's design, and she decided to leave him.
By the end of the fighting she had come to feel something special for $$キリコ$$, and followed after him when he set out alone after losing $$フィアナ$$.

library.pt_040:r_7a6b76feaa6f3e12.text:
A cardinal of the pan-galactic society $$マーティアル$$.
An ambitious man who covets $$マーティアル$$'s next papal seat, when he learned of the revival of $$キリコ$$, known as the 'Untouchable,' he ordered his own daughter $$テイタニア$$ to assassinate him.
$$キリコ$$'s fate ended up unconfirmed, but he used $$テイタニア$$'s accomplishment to strengthen his political standing.

library.pt_040:r_c263490d71f74063.text:
A cardinal of the pan-galactic society $$マーティアル$$.
An ambitious man who covets $$マーティアル$$'s next papal seat, when he learned of the revival of $$キリコ$$, known as the 'Untouchable,' he ordered his own daughter $$テイタニア$$ to assassinate him.
$$キリコ$$'s fate ended up unconfirmed, but he used $$テイタニア$$'s accomplishment to strengthen his political standing.
Later, he framed his rival Cardinal $$グノー$$ and had him killed to cover up the truth. It was also revealed that it was $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$ himself who had arranged for $$テイタニア$$ to be turned into a $$ネクスタント$$, exposing a ruthlessness that would use any means to achieve his ends.
He eventually achieved his ambition of taking the papal seat, and ordered $$テイタニア$$ to assassinate $$キリコ$$ when he boarded the Alegium to reclaim $$フィアナ$$. But when he witnessed $$キリコ$$ destroy the auxiliary brain that served as the $$ネクスタント$$'s heart, the defeat of the power he had believed in left him a hollow shell of himself.

library.pt_040:r_e68a074da1a34742.text:
The 712th $$法皇$$ of the pan-galactic society $$マーティアル$$.
He has held the papal seat for as long as 41 years, but has grown so old that he can no longer converse with others without an interpreter.

library.pt_040:r_7fc9d4c24badd996.text:
The 712th $$法皇$$ of the pan-galactic society $$マーティアル$$.
He has held the papal seat for as long as 41 years, but has grown so old that he can no longer converse with others without an interpreter.
However, this was all an act, and when he stepped down after naming $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$ his successor, he handed over the seat while clearly stating, 'There is no faith here.'

library.pt_040:r_29ba12e8eb9a7c28.text:
A cardinal of the pan-galactic society $$マーティアル$$.
He is $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$' rival in contention for the next papal seat.

library.pt_040:r_7413ef6053a8f852.text:
A cardinal of the pan-galactic society $$マーティアル$$.
He is $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$' rival in contention for the next papal seat.
The papal election was proceeding in $$グノー$$'s favor, but he was brought down by a trap set by $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$. When he later confronted $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$ to expose the conspiracy, he was shot dead to cover up the truth.

library.pt_040:r_caee38a34962a3e2.text:
A priest of the pan-galactic society $$マーティアル$$.
As Cardinal $$グノー$$'s confidant, he worked behind the scenes to help him take the papal seat.

library.pt_040:r_149e41221308ff89.text:
A priest of the pan-galactic society $$マーティアル$$.
As Cardinal $$グノー$$'s confidant, he worked behind the scenes to help him take the papal seat.
But $$グノー$$ fell victim to a scheme and was brought down, and he too was shot dead along with $$グノー$$ by $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$, who was chosen as $$法皇$$.

library.pt_040:r_1d00c83d09a8b869.text:
A young man in a world sealed within the Realm of Conflict, who came to be called the Singularity. 19 years old.
A hot-blooded, straightforward young man who seems like the typical hero type at first glance, but is at heart a shallow, incorrigible womanizer. Even in the world before the spacetime chaos, he carried on with countless women, and in particular kept up trysts with his girlfriend Tina whenever he could steal time away from military duty.
After being transferred to the world 20 years later, he was rescued by the $$ファクトリー$$ caravan of Emaan, led by Shaia, and told that he was the Singularity. Learning that he was the cause of the world's chaos and that his own existence was needed to repair it, he resolved to travel with the $$ファクトリー$$.
Though he mainly courted Mimsy, he would make passes at any woman he saw on his travels, repeatedly causing trouble because of it.
He has a natural talent for piloting, having mastered the inertial control system, a technology unknown to him, after only a little practice once it was explained to him. He drove back the Chiram forces, who sought to seize the Singularity by targeting the Groma, time and again while piloting the $$オーガス$$.
Eventually he crosses paths with $$オルソン#50$$, another Singularity, and Athena, the daughter born to him and Tina. The two were hostile toward each other at first because of their positions, but gradually came to join hands and deepen their bond.
In the end, together with $$オルソン#50$$, he plunged into the Great Singularity, once a $$時空震動弾$$, and met their past selves within it. This spacetime chaos had occurred because another personality shared by Kei and $$オルソン#50$$ existed within the same time. To undo the chaos, the two of them pulled the trigger on their own past selves.
Among the infinite possible futures shown in the epilogue was a glimpse of him holding a child born to him and Mimsy.

library.pt_040:r_206b211d4587aedc.text:
A young man in a world sealed within the Realm of Conflict, who came to be called the other Singularity.
He was born the same year as Kei, but because he appeared in the chaotic era five years earlier than Kei, he is five years older, at 25.
When he appeared in the chaotic era, he was taken in by General $$マイケル$$ Henderson of the Chiram forces. Through that connection, he met the general's beloved daughter Tina, and likewise his granddaughter Athena. After Tina and $$マイケル$$ were killed in an attack by the Mu, he became Athena's guardian and teacher, supporting her both publicly and privately.
Recognized both as a Singularity, a figure of great importance, and for his accomplishments before the chaotic era, he was given the exceptional rank of Special Major General in the Chiram forces. He was at odds with Kei at first, but once Chiram began pushing a spacetime repair plan that did not use the Singularities, he left the army and returned to being a comrade fighting for the same goal.
In the end, he plunged into the Great Singularity together with Kei, and confronted his past self. He pulled the trigger to bring the chaos to an end.
Among the infinite possible futures shown in the epilogue was a glimpse of him sharing a kiss with Athena.

library.pt_040:r_c492805c4093670f.text:
A humanoid made by the Mu.
Outwardly indistinguishable from a human girl, she was displayed for sale in Atlantis after being swept up and carried off in a spacetime transfer. Kei bought her there, and she became a member of the Groma.
Because she was designed to become friends with humans, she has emotional circuits equivalent to a human's. Because of this, she came in time to fall in love with Kei, her own benefactor.
Having been built for nursing and repair work, she handled everything from everyday chores to mechanical maintenance.
During the final battle with the Mu, she drove off the enemy by diverting her own energy into the Dimora's main cannon to save Mimsy. But by the time Kei rushed to her side, she had already used up all her energy, and she closed her eyes in his arms. She then vanished into the depths of space, seen off by Kei's tears.

library.pt_040:r_2920eaf9a6e912ad.text:
A Newtype boy who joins the $$エゥーゴ$$, and the pilot of the $$Ｚガンダム$$. 17 years old.
Originally an ordinary, somewhat sensitive boy attending high school on the space colony 'Green Noa.' He has a complex about his feminine-sounding name, $$カミーユ$$, and threw himself into masculine pursuits like homo avis (a simple glider) and karate. With both parents technical officers in the Federation forces, he grew up well versed in mechanics, skilled enough to win the Jr. Mobile Suit tournament.
However, after Jerid mocked his name and the resulting friction with him put $$カミーユ$$ at odds with the $$ティターンズ$$, he ended up helping $$クワトロ$$ and the others steal the $$ガンダムＭｋ－Ⅱ$$, and joined the $$エゥーゴ$$ as a result.
He awakened to his abilities as a Newtype in the course of battle, and gradually became an ace pilot for the $$エゥーゴ$$.
At first he simply fought out of resentment toward the $$ティターンズ$$, but through his encounters and partings with adults like $$クワトロ$$ and $$アムロ$$, and with women like $$フォウ$$ and Rosamia, he grew tremendously as a person. As he searched for a way to end the war, he expanded his own consciousness out into space.
At the end of the TV series, $$シロッコ$$ dragged his mind down with him, leaving $$カミーユ$$ with a deep wound in his heart, but at the end of the film version he shakes it off, and he and $$ファ$$ confirm each other's safety in each other's arms.

library.pt_040:r_2bcc7cb5a4d785ca.text:
$$カミーユ$$'s childhood friend. 17 years old.
Because she and her parents were known to be acquainted with $$カミーユ$$ after his theft of the $$ガンダムＭｋ－Ⅱ$$, they were captured by Bask. After being rescued by $$ブライト$$, she joined the $$エゥーゴ$$ and volunteered as a pilot, both out of defiance toward the $$ティターンズ$$ and to stay by $$カミーユ$$'s side. Though troubled by her own lack of skill, she fought through the entire Gryps War.
She has a nurturing, fussing personality, and had long kept after $$カミーユ$$ about his lifestyle and habits. $$カミーユ$$ apparently found her nagging tiresome, if only inwardly. Perhaps because of this personality, she also ended up in charge of looking after the orphans Shinta and Qum, whom $$クワトロ$$ brought aboard the Argama.
In the TV series, when her beloved $$カミーユ$$ suffered a mental breakdown during the final battle, she left the battlefield to devote herself to caring for and nursing him. In the film version, however, the two are seen rejoicing together in each other's safety.

library.pt_040:r_b5a17f59e366cd5d.text:
An Enhanced Human trained at the Murasame Research Institute, and the pilot of the Psycho Gundam. Her nominal rank is Ensign.
She is normally cheerful and lively, but riding the Psycho Gundam exposes her to mind control waves, transforming her into a violent personality accompanied by intense headaches.
She has lost her past memories, and this loss has become a psychological wound that binds her tightly. Even the name $$フォウ$$ is not her real name, but simply what she is called as the fourth test subject at the Murasame Research Institute. Still, believing the claim that defeating the $$ガンダムＭｋ－Ⅱ$$ would restore her memories, she endured the headaches and fought on in the Psycho Gundam.
Meeting $$カミーユ$$ lets her feel the warmth of the human heart, but she later learns that he is the pilot of the $$ガンダムＭｋ－Ⅱ$$, and this troubles her greatly.
In both the TV series and the film version, she throws off her psychological chains, throws herself in harm's way for $$カミーユ$$'s sake, and loses her life amid the flames of battle.

library.pt_040:r_46ab88d386b281f8.text:
A pilot originally in the $$ティターンズ$$. She defected to the $$エゥーゴ$$ after witnessing one of Bask's despicable schemes firsthand. Her rank is Lieutenant.
Her high piloting skill was valued by the $$エゥーゴ$$ as well, and she was entrusted with mainstay units like the Rick Dias, the $$ガンダムＭｋ－Ⅱ$$, and the Super Gundam, all of which she handled with ease.
She has a strong will to act on her own convictions, and a soldier's severity. At the same time, she also has a feminine gentleness, shown in the way she looked out for the younger $$カミーユ$$ and $$カツ$$. She always kept Henken at arm's length whenever he approached her, but she does not seem to have been entirely indifferent to him.
In the final battle against the $$ティターンズ$$, after her immobilized unit was left drifting following Reccoa's downing, she stepped outside and was struck all over by debris from Yazan's bombardment. She entrusted the rest to $$カミーユ$$ when he rushed to her side, and breathed her last in his arms.

library.pt_040:r_d2f3e41f7f5f829e.text:
A boy soldier who joins the $$エゥーゴ$$.
Because he had boarded the White Base as a refugee during the $$一年戦争$$, he was raised after the war as the adopted son of the married couple $$隼人$$ and Frau. But when he and his family visited $$アムロ$$, he volunteered to join the $$エゥーゴ$$ himself, and joined up with the Audhumla alongside $$アムロ$$.
A far cry from his quiet early childhood, he has grown reckless and hot-blooded. He holds a rivalry with $$カミーユ$$, who is his age, and has gone as far as sortieing without orders and ignoring commands.
He falls for Sarah, one of $$シロッコ$$'s subordinates whom he meets on the battlefield, and tries to persuade her to leave him. But she does not accept his words, and dies protecting $$シロッコ$$ instead.
In the final battle against the $$ティターンズ$$, he distinguishes himself by saving $$エマ$$ from a tight spot. But while fleeing from Yazan, he collides with a meteorite and is scattered into space.

library.pt_040:r_42bcd8c8b91a5847.text:
One of the central figures who laid the foundations of the $$エゥーゴ$$. His rank is Captain.
A man of many mysteries who wears sunglasses as if to hide his true face. His true identity is $$シャア・アズナブル$$, the Red Comet of the Principality of Zeon, who had gone missing after the end of the $$一年戦争$$.
Incidentally, $$クワトロ$$ means the number '4' in Italian, signifying the fourth name he has used, after his real name Casval, his earthbound alias Edouard, and his Zeon alias $$シャア$$.
At first he fought on the front lines with his high mobile suit piloting skill, riding the Rick Dias and the Hyaku Shiki. But his reunion with $$アムロ$$ and the assassination of Brigadier General Blex, the $$エゥーゴ$$'s representative, among other events, led him to step into the spotlight as a political leader.
In the final phase, he fights a one-on-one duel with $$ハマーン$$ on the stage of the Colony Laser, but his unit is wrecked. Though he manages to drive $$ハマーン$$ off, he vanishes in the explosion, and goes missing once again.

library.pt_040:r_001be1f7e51f4d31.text:
An ace pilot of $$カラバ$$. His rank is Captain. 24 years old.
A man who fought through the $$一年戦争$$ in the RX-78 Gundam, now a figure of near legend. But after the war, he was regarded as a threat and left to languish in an unimportant post on Earth under Federation surveillance.
A sudden visit from Frau, $$カツ$$, and the rest of the family became the catalyst for his decision to rise again. After deserting to join $$カラバ$$, he acted alongside his old rival $$シャア$$ and the youthful $$カミーユ$$. In time he regained his edge in battle, and became a core member of $$カラバ$$'s fighting force, piloting the Rick Dias and the Gundam Dijeh.

library.pt_040:r_6e8d4508728dcd9c.text:
A member of $$カラバ$$, the $$エゥーゴ$$'s support organization.
An active woman, but her habit of speaking her mind the moment she thinks it often earned her the resentment of those around her.
When she made contact with the Audhumla, she was delighted to finally meet $$アムロ$$, the hero of the $$一年戦争$$ in whom she had long held an interest. She wasted no time repeatedly making bold advances on him, and eventually came to support an invigorated $$アムロ$$ as his girlfriend.

library.pt_040:r_414b8e4ba26deeca.text:
A subordinate of $$クワトロ$$'s who joins the $$エゥーゴ$$. His rank is Lieutenant.
He formerly belonged to the old Principality of Zeon forces, and had also fought in the $$一年戦争$$. One of the few veteran pilots aboard the Argama, he was a good senior figure for $$カミーユ$$.
He was also deeply trusted by $$クワトロ$$, and would sometimes take command of the mobile suit corps in his stead.
In the closing stages of the Gryps War, he died protecting $$ファ$$'s $$メタス$$.

library.pt_040:r_811b7ba359460452.text:
The regent of $$アクシズ$$, a resource asteroid where the remnants of the Principality of Zeon's forces have gathered.
She has installed the 8-year-old $$ミネバ$$, the orphaned daughter of Dozle Zabi, as a figurehead, and leads the whole of $$アクシズ$$'s forces as its de facto leader.
Fierce and cold-blooded by nature. Championing the resurgence of Zeon, she possesses the outstanding political skill that raised $$アクシズ$$, once biding its time as a mere asteroid base, into a major power to rival the $$ティターンズ$$ and the $$エゥーゴ$$.
She is also an exceptionally gifted Newtype who pilots her personal unit, the $$キュベレイ$$, displaying overwhelming skill on the battlefield.
She shares a history with $$クワトロ$$, and holds complicated feelings toward him that could be called both love and hatred. In the battle of Gryps II, when $$クワトロ$$'s Hyaku Shiki was swallowed by an explosion at the end of their duel, she murmured her feelings to herself, sounding lonely.

library.pt_040:r_4ccc4cfcd905a83a.text:
Captain of the Jupitris, which leads the Earth Federation government's Jupiter fleet. His rank is Captain. 26 years old.
He possesses high Newtype ability and great charisma. A man of many talents who does everything perfectly, from mobile suit design and piloting to planning and commanding operations to handling women. His power captivated Sarah, turned Reccoa away from the $$エゥーゴ$$, and won over even the difficult Yazan.
He openly declares that 'women will rule the world after the war,' and acts for the sake of his own ideals and ambitions.
After returning to the Earth $$スフィア$$ he joined the $$ティターンズ$$, but his talent-fueled ambition could never be contained within an army, and he seized control of the $$ティターンズ$$ by assassinating Jamitov amid the chaos.
In the end, he boards The O, a mobile suit of his own design, and fights a fierce battle against $$カミーユ$$, only to be defeated by a young man protected by countless souls.

library.pt_040:r_b7360722d80a998b.text:
A Newtype pilot belonging to the Earth Federation Forces' Londo Bell unit. His rank is Captain.
In the $$一年戦争$$, he rode the RX-78 Gundam into numerous battles, growing as a Newtype and leaving behind a legendary combat record.
But after the war, the Earth Federation viewed his abilities with suspicion, and forced him to live under virtual house arrest. Even so, during the Gryps War he joined $$カラバ$$, the $$エゥーゴ$$'s support organization, and fought the $$ティターンズ$$.
After the First Neo Zeon War, he belonged to Londo Bell, the Federation forces' independent outside unit. He fought the Neo Zeon forces led by $$シャア・アズナブル$$, his former comrade and now bitter enemy.
At the time of the $$一年戦争$$ he was an introverted, naive boy, but through the war he met many people, and through his many experiences grew tremendously as a person.
In the Second Neo Zeon War, he attempts to stop $$アクシズ$$ from falling to Earth using the $$νガンダム$$, which he himself helped design and develop.

library.pt_040:r_eaaad027a7988299.text:
A Newtype pilot belonging to the Earth Federation Forces' Londo Bell unit. His rank is Captain.
In the $$一年戦争$$, he rode the RX-78 Gundam into numerous battles, growing as a Newtype and leaving behind a legendary combat record.
But after the war, the Earth Federation viewed his abilities with suspicion, and forced him to live under virtual house arrest. Even so, during the Gryps War he joined $$カラバ$$, the $$エゥーゴ$$'s support organization, and fought the $$ティターンズ$$.
After the First Neo Zeon War, he belonged to Londo Bell, the Federation forces' independent outside unit. He fought the Neo Zeon forces led by $$シャア・アズナブル$$, his former comrade and now bitter enemy.
At the time of the $$一年戦争$$ he was an introverted, naive boy, but through the war he met many people, and through his many experiences grew tremendously as a person.
In the Second Neo Zeon War, he attempts to stop $$アクシズ$$ from falling to Earth using the $$νガンダム$$, which he himself helped design and develop. Through the supernatural power of the Psycoframe, he succeeds in pushing $$アクシズ$$ back, but in doing so goes missing along with $$シャア$$, vanishing from history.

library.pt_040:r_9b0ff0bfea864484.text:
Supreme commander of Neo Zeon.
His real name is Casval Rem Deikun. He is the orphaned son of Zeon Zum Deikun, who was murdered by the Zabi family. In the $$一年戦争$$ he won fame as the 'Red Comet' for his outstanding tactical eye and mobile suit piloting. In the Gryps War he called himself $$クワトロ・バジーナ$$ and fought to overthrow the $$ティターンズ$$, but disappeared after his duel with $$ハマーン$$ during the battle over the Colony Laser.
However, three years after the end of the First Neo Zeon War, he reappears in the Earth $$スフィア$$ leading a reborn Neo Zeon. The Spacenoids, suffering under the Earth Federation's oppressive rule, welcomed him with overwhelming joy, and many colonies came to cooperate with Neo Zeon.
As Neo Zeon's supreme commander, he wages war against the Earth Federation through political maneuvering and scheming. But $$ララァ・スン$$ still lives on in his heart even now, and it is because of her that he wishes to settle his score with $$アムロ$$, 14 years in the making.

library.pt_040:r_c6c09f0666ebb697.text:
Supreme commander of Neo Zeon.
His real name is Casval Rem Deikun. He is the orphaned son of Zeon Zum Deikun, who was murdered by the Zabi family. In the $$一年戦争$$ he won fame as the 'Red Comet' for his outstanding tactical eye and mobile suit piloting. In the Gryps War he called himself $$クワトロ・バジーナ$$ and fought to overthrow the $$ティターンズ$$, but disappeared after his duel with $$ハマーン$$ during the battle over the Colony Laser.
However, three years after the end of the First Neo Zeon War, he reappears in the Earth $$スフィア$$ leading a reborn Neo Zeon. The Spacenoids, suffering under the Earth Federation's oppressive rule, welcomed him with overwhelming joy, and many colonies came to cooperate with Neo Zeon.
As Neo Zeon's supreme commander, he wages war against the Earth Federation through political maneuvering and scheming. But $$ララァ・スン$$ still lives on in his heart even now, and it is because of her that he wishes to settle his score with $$アムロ$$, 14 years in the making.
And then, to drive humanity from the Earth, he carries out the Earth cooling operation. He faces his final battle with $$アムロ$$ on the stage of the falling $$アクシズ$$, and amid the fighting, he is enveloped in the light of the Psycoframe and goes missing along with $$アムロ$$.

library.pt_040:r_6a69f0bf727e7ecd.text:
The only daughter of $$アデナウアー$$, the Earth Federation Forces' Deputy Chief of Staff.
Free-spirited and prone to intense mood swings, she has a sharp eye for people.
She has an interest in Newtypes, and once trained in India.

library.pt_040:r_66f57d75a8cbc1c9.text:
A pilot of the Neo Zeon forces.
His unit is the $$ヤクト・ドーガ$$, a mobile suit for Newtypes.
He is an Enhanced Human from the Newtype Research Institute, of which $$ナナイ・ミゲル$$ is director.
He is ambitious by nature, greedily seeking to improve his own abilities, always watching for a chance to advance. His Newtype abilities are indeed high; he was the only one among the members enhanced at the institute able to use the psycommu weapon known as the Funnel.
He recognizes $$クェス$$, who comes to $$シャア$$, as a genuine Newtype, and finds himself drawn to her.

library.pt_040:r_bdea0d1b634a1c26.text:
A pilot of the Neo Zeon forces.
His unit is the $$ヤクト・ドーガ$$, a mobile suit for Newtypes.
He is an Enhanced Human from the Newtype Research Institute, of which $$ナナイ・ミゲル$$ is director.
He is ambitious by nature, greedily seeking to improve his own abilities, always watching for a chance to advance. His Newtype abilities are indeed high; he was the only one among the members enhanced at the institute able to use the psycommu weapon known as the Funnel.
He recognizes $$クェス$$, who comes to $$シャア$$, as a genuine Newtype, and finds himself drawn to her.
In the battle for $$アクシズ$$, he distinguishes himself by shooting down every nuclear missile launched by Londo Bell, but is shot down himself in battle against $$アムロ$$, piloting the $$νガンダム$$.

library.pt_040:r_0999a88a9cd4ab8a.text:
A pilot belonging to Neo Zeon.
He commands a platoon of Gyla Dogas, and paints his own unit in his personal color, blue. He prides himself on his high mobile suit piloting skill, dislikes cheap tricks, and believes mobile suits should mainly be used for close combat.
He also despises Enhanced Humans, and would sometimes clash with $$ギュネイ$$ because of it.

library.pt_040:r_a3aefb0f5f9dcfbd.text:

In the battle for $$アクシズ$$, he attacks the $$ラー・カイラム$$, but is killed in action by a direct hit from anti-air fire fired by $$チェーン$$, aided by the Psycoframe.

library.pt_040:r_1bf3aa9ffc62c073.text:
A tactical officer of Neo Zeon, and director of the Newtype Research Institute.
As a tactical officer, she was deeply trusted by $$シャア$$, entrusted with commanding the surprise attack on Ruuna Two. She has also left her mark at the Newtype Research Institute, having raised $$ギュネイ$$ among others.
She is $$シャア$$'s mistress, and supports him privately as a woman. But she made no secret of her displeasure at $$クェス$$, whom $$シャア$$ brought along.

library.pt_040:r_85c7a9f03be38c7b.text:
A technical officer of the Earth Federation Forces.
On assignment to the Anaheim Electronics company, she is in charge of developing the $$νガンダム$$. She holds feelings for her superior officer $$アムロ$$, and burns with extraordinary enthusiasm to adjust the Psycoframe in hopes of being of use to him.
In the midst of the battle for $$アクシズ$$, she sorties in a battle-damaged $$リ・ガズィ$$ to deliver a Psycoframe sample to $$アムロ$$, hoping it will help improve the $$νガンダム$$'s performance.

library.pt_040:r_aa110ab44d20db3b.text:
A technical officer of the Earth Federation Forces.
On assignment to the Anaheim Electronics company, she is in charge of developing the $$νガンダム$$. She holds feelings for her superior officer $$アムロ$$, and burns with extraordinary enthusiasm to adjust the Psycoframe in hopes of being of use to him.
In the midst of the battle for $$アクシズ$$, she sorties in a battle-damaged $$リ・ガズィ$$ to deliver a Psycoframe sample to $$アムロ$$, hoping it will help improve the $$νガンダム$$'s performance. She then intervenes between $$ハサウェイ$$ and $$クェス$$, shooting down the $$α・アジール$$. But $$ハサウェイ$$, enraged at $$クェス$$'s death, shoots her, and she loses her life.

library.pt_040:r_11ee779a12307e2f.text:
The son born to $$ブライト$$ and Mirai. He has a younger sister, Chammy.
Affected by the war between Neo Zeon and the Earth Federation, he tries to head to Londenion together with his mother and sister, but because $$アデナウアー$$ uses his political privilege to cut in, they can only obtain a single ticket, and $$ハサウェイ$$ ends up traveling into space alone.
There he meets $$クェス$$, and finds himself strongly drawn to her free spirit.

library.pt_040:r_3a8825da81b51378.text:
The son born to $$ブライト$$ and Mirai. He has a younger sister, Chammy.
Affected by the war between Neo Zeon and the Earth Federation, he tries to head to Londenion together with his mother and sister, but because $$アデナウアー$$ uses his political privilege to cut in, they can only obtain a single ticket, and $$ハサウェイ$$ ends up traveling into space alone.
There he meets $$クェス$$, and finds himself strongly drawn to her free spirit.
After $$クェス$$ leaves for $$シャア$$, he stows away aboard the $$ラー・カイラム$$ to see her again.
In the battle for $$アクシズ$$, he sorties in a $$ジェガン$$, but $$クェス$$ is shot down before his eyes. Enraged, he shoots down $$チェーン$$, who had shot her, in turn.

library.pt_040:r_0ebb8ce68048aa81.text:
Chief mechanic of the $$ラー・カイラム$$, Londo Bell's flagship.
Formerly a mechanic aboard the $$エゥーゴ$$'s Argama, he has a sure hand and is strict and demanding about maintenance. Ordinarily, though, he is a mild-mannered, easygoing man, and is deeply trusted by the pilots.
He and Kayra of the mobile suit corps are a couple.

library.pt_040:r_0ec137a65b2c3874.text:
Chief mechanic of the $$ラー・カイラム$$, Londo Bell's flagship.
Formerly a mechanic aboard the $$エゥーゴ$$'s Argama, he has a sure hand and is strict and demanding about maintenance. Ordinarily, though, he is a mild-mannered, easygoing man, and is deeply trusted by the pilots.
He and Kayra of the mobile suit corps are a couple.
In the battle for $$アクシズ$$, he is caught in an explosion when the area near the catapult deck is hit.

library.pt_040:r_88303de7661f1423.text:
Deputy Chief of Staff of the Earth Federation government.
A selfish type who does not hesitate to use his privileges as a politician, such as securing shuttle tickets for himself. He also has a shrewd political side, as when he gave up a spare ticket to Mirai, who carried a letter of introduction from an acquaintance he owed a favor.
He is $$クェス$$'s father, but does not get along with his daughter. $$クェス$$ and his mistress Catherine are also at odds, so his private life is far from harmonious.
Bearing a special mandate to negotiate peace with Neo Zeon, he meets with $$シャア$$.

library.pt_040:r_3b7bed4c3cf9d7e9.text:
Deputy Chief of Staff of the Earth Federation government.
A selfish type who does not hesitate to use his privileges as a politician, such as securing shuttle tickets for himself. He also has a shrewd political side, as when he gave up a spare ticket to Mirai, who carried a letter of introduction from an acquaintance he owed a favor.
He is $$クェス$$'s father, but does not get along with his daughter. $$クェス$$ and his mistress Catherine are also at odds, so his private life is far from harmonious.
Bearing a special mandate to negotiate peace with Neo Zeon, he meets with $$シャア$$. The negotiations seemed to succeed, but it was all a trap set by $$シャア$$. Furthermore, during Neo Zeon's surprise attack on Ruuna Two, he loses his life to an attack from the $$ヤクト・ドーガ$$ piloted by $$クェス$$.

library.pt_040:r_f08dda1644853063.text:
A Newtype pilot killed in the $$一年戦争$$.
While alive, she met $$アムロ$$ and formed a bond of understanding with him. Even after dying to protect $$シャア$$, she continues to exert a great influence over both $$アムロ$$ and $$シャア$$.

library.pt_040:r_039b9dee6745abe3.text:
A close aide to $$シャア$$.
He advises $$シャア$$, the supreme commander, in a staff-officer capacity. He puts $$シャア$$'s charisma to political use, contributing to the expansion of Neo Zeon's power.
He was also present at the peace negotiations in Londenion.

library.pt_040:r_af3a406d3739a581.text:
An agent sent from the L1 colony cluster as part of $$オペレーション・メテオ$$. 16 years old.
Having grown up undergoing severe combat training from an early age, he possesses outstanding physical ability. His bodily toughness is beyond that of an ordinary person, to the point that he can fall from a 50-story building without dying, or heal his own broken bones.
He also excels not only in combat but in skills such as sabotage and mobile suit repair.
Taciturn and prone to avoiding involvement with others to an extreme degree, he is at heart a kind-hearted boy, and gradually regained his human feelings through his encounters with $$リリーナ$$ and the other Gundam pilots.
Piloting the $$ウイングガンダムゼロ$$ and mastering the Zero System, he trusted in the future he saw there and in his own feelings, and fought against the $$ホワイトファング$$ led by $$ゼクス$$.
In the final battle, he rescues $$リリーナ$$, who had been held captive inside Libra, and settles matters with $$ゼクス$$. He then destroys Libra as it falls toward Earth, saving the world from a nuclear winter.

During the $$マリーメイア$$ army's rebellion, he was quick to act. He recovered the $$ウイングガンダムゼロ$$, which had been jettisoned into the sun, and fought a fierce battle against $$五飛$$, who had become an enemy of the world.
His reckless disregard for his own safety awakened $$リリーナ$$'s courage, becoming the force that brought the fighting to an end.

library.pt_040:r_20d694d8c6c4937b.text:
An agent sent from the Sweeper group living near the L2 colony cluster as part of $$オペレーション・メテオ$$. 16 years old.
He pilots the $$ガンダムデスサイズヘル$$.
His personality is one of clearly expressed emotions, and he generally behaves cheerfully. He can sometimes be stubborn, and is the most boyish of the colony-born Gundam pilots. His motto is 'I run and I hide, but I never lie,' and when asked why he calls himself the God of Death, he says it is because 'I've never seen a miracle, but I've seen plenty of dead men.'
While infiltrating the lunar base, he meets $$ヒルデ・シュバイカー$$, an OZ volunteer soldier, and through their repeated interactions succeeds in opening the eyes of the once-fanatically loyal OZ believer. From then on, the two come to cooperate with one another.
In the final battle, he infiltrates Libra using information from $$ヒルデ$$, freeing the doctors held captive there. He carries them to the Peacemillion, successfully altering the course of the falling Libra.

After the suppression of $$マリーメイア$$'s rebellion, he runs a junk shop on a colony together with $$ヒルデ$$.

library.pt_040:r_05391d823a640dfd.text:
An agent sent from the L3 colony cluster as part of $$オペレーション・メテオ$$. Estimated age 16.
He pilots the Gundam Heavyarms Kai.
He has flown from battlefield to battlefield as a mercenary since childhood, and is a quiet, composed boy whose background remains largely unknown. But he is not a cold-hearted person, and holds a caring warmth for his comrades.
He is especially close with $$カトル$$ among the Gundam pilots, and when $$カトル$$ despaired of the colonies' stance and went berserk, $$トロワ$$ talked him down without regard for his own safety. His own unit was wrecked and he went missing, but he succeeded in restoring $$カトル$$'s sanity in exchange, an act that showed his utter disregard for his own well-being.
He was later found having lost both his memory and his will to fight, and was sheltered at a circus troupe where he was hiding out, posing as Catherine's brother. He answers $$カトル$$'s call and returns to the front once more, but promises Catherine that he will come back alive.

library.pt_040:r_5d4286367aa91d7f.text:
An agent sent from the L3 colony cluster as part of $$オペレーション・メテオ$$. Estimated age 16.
He pilots the Gundam Heavyarms Kai.

The name $$トロワ・バートン$$ is not his real name; the name itself originally belonged to Heavyarms's intended pilot, who was killed in a dispute during $$オペレーション・メテオ$$. He happened to witness the killing, and was given this name by Doctor S to cover up the murder, living as $$トロワ・バートン$$ ever since.
In $$マリーメイア$$'s rebellion, he infiltrates the $$マリーメイア$$ army to investigate from within. In the battle over Brussels, he puts on a brilliant display of fighting in the Heavyarms Kai, delivered to him by $$カトル$$.

library.pt_040:r_d999219cd54d2842.text:
The heir of the Winner family, wealthy magnates of the L4 colony cluster. 16 years old.
In $$オペレーション・メテオ$$, he came down to Earth as an agent and served as the pilot of the Gundam Sandrock Kai.
Raised in a wealthy, warm household, he has a gentle, kind personality. At the same time, he combines a battle sense that lets him handle a Gundam expertly with a talent for commanding those around him.
He has 29 half-sisters, and leads the 40-strong Maganac Corps. Wherever he goes, he is surrounded by crowds of people, all of whom adore him.
However, when his father, who had steadfastly opposed OZ, was killed by the colonists, $$カトル$$ went berserk. He assembled the forbidden mobile suit $$ウイングガンダムゼロ$$ and destroyed a colony with it. $$トロワ$$'s desperate persuasion finally brought him back to himself, but only after a great sacrifice had already been paid.
Afterward, he acknowledges his mistake and works tirelessly to atone for it, and even succeeds in bringing the missing $$トロワ$$ back to the battlefield.
He also grew spiritually, coming to hold together the Gundam pilots, who might otherwise have fallen apart.

He also grew spiritually, coming to hold together the Gundam pilots, who might otherwise have fallen apart.
After the war's end, he proposes scrapping the Gundams, gathers up every Gundam except $$五飛$$'s, loads them onto a resource satellite, and launches them into the sun.
But when the $$マリーメイア$$ army's rebellion breaks out, he sets out to recover the launched Gundams. With only around five seconds of rendezvous time between the recovery ship and the resource satellite, he successfully boards the satellite, delivers the Gundams to the pilots, and becomes a major force in putting down the rebellion.
